# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 05 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale & Rental Market

- **S$1.65M Bishan maisonette sets new record for Singapore's priciest executive flat** - A high-floor executive maisonette in Bishan changed hands for S$1.65 million on 4 August 2026, making it both the highest-priced HDB resale flat in Bishan and the most expensive executive flat ever recorded in Singapore. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/s1-65m-bishan-maisonette-becomes-singapores-priciest-executive-flat-to-date/)

- **Private and HDB rents continue to edge up despite new supply** - Private residential rents rose 0.7% in 2Q2026 while HDB rents grew 0.4%, with tighter supply and steady tenant demand keeping both markets in positive territory, and growth projected to continue through the rest of 2026. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/why-rental-prices-in-singapore-are-still-climbing-despite-more-homes-coming-this-year/)

## Land Sales & New Launches

- **Berlayar Drive GLS site draws sole bid, sets new RCR land price record** - A Hong Leong–GuocoLand joint venture submitted the only bid of S$576.78 million (S$1,515 psf ppr) for the Berlayar Drive Government Land Sale site, establishing a new benchmark for Rest of Central Region residential GLS sites, though analysts noted developers are becoming more selective with land acquisitions. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/berlayar-drive-gls-site-1515-psf-ppr-hong-leong-guocoland/)

- **Dunearn House sells 56% of units in first sales weekend despite strong preview turnout** - The first private residential project at the Turf City precinct moved only 212 of its available units during its launch weekend, even after drawing 5,900 visitors at the preview, pointing to cautious buyer sentiment at new launches. [Source](https://www.propertysoul.com/2026/08/02/dunearn-house/)

## Policy & Market Structure

- **Extended ABSD timeline for large en bloc sites could revive collective sale activity** - Under new ABSD rules, developers acquiring large collective sale projects now have six to seven years (up from 5.5) to complete and sell, a change that may increase developer appetite for older condominiums going to en bloc. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-change-boost-en-bloc-chances-for-older-condos-buyers-still-need-to-be-careful/)
